plt.rcParams['ytick.labelsize'] = 8

    'NCD': '#B8D4ED',
    'Injury': '#F5D4AD'

CAT_COLORS_DARK = {
    'Communicable': '#8B2020',
    'NCD': '#1E3F5E',
    'Injury': '#8B5015'
}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12), dpi=200)
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FAFAF8')

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1.15, 1], hspace=0.35, wspace=0.28,
                       left=0.06, right=0.96, top=0.93, bottom=0.06)

# ---- PANEL A: Slope/Bump Chart - Top 10 DALY Causes Rank Change ----

causes_2024 = [d for d in top10 if d['year'] == 2024]

for d in causes_1990:
    all_causes[d['cause']] = {'rank_1990': d['rank'], 'category': d['category'], 'dalys_1990': d['dalys_millions']}
for d in causes_2024:
    if d['cause'] in all_causes:
        all_causes[d['cause']]['rank_2024'] = d['rank']
        all_causes[d['cause']]['dalys_2024'] = d['dalys_millions']
    else:
        all_causes[d['cause']] = {'rank_2024': d['rank'], 'category': d['category'],

    r90 = all_causes[c].get('rank_1990')
    r24 = all_causes[c].get('rank_2024')
    if r90 is not None and r24 is not None:

        return r90
    else:

    r24 = all_causes[c].get('rank_2024')
    if r90 is not None and r24 is not None:

    elif r24 is None:
        significant_shifts.append((c, r90, None, 'dropped'))

    r90 = all_causes[c].get('rank_1990')
    if r90 is not None:

    y_positions_right[c] = 11 - all_causes[c]['rank_2024']

    yr = y_positions_right.get(c)

    color = CAT_COLORS[cat]
    alpha = 0.7
    lw = 1.8

    if yl is not None and yr is not None:
        # Create bezier-like curve

        # Curved path

        mid_y = (yl + yr) / 2
        # Quadratic bezier control point
        cx = mid_x
        cy = mid_y + (yl - yr) * 0.15  # slight curve based on slope direction

        t = np.linspace(0, 1, 40)
        bx = x_left + t * (x_right - x_left)
        by = yl + t * (yl - 5) * 0.3
        ax_a.plot(bx, by, color=color, alpha=0.3, lw=1.2, linestyle='--', zorder=1)
    elif yl is None and yr is not None:
        # New entry - fade in from left
        t = np.linspace(0, 1, 40)
        bx = x_left + t * (x_right - x_left)
        by = (yr - 5) * 0.3 + t * (yr - (yr - 5) * 0.3)
        ax_a.plot(bx, by, color=color, alpha=0.5, lw=1.2, linestyle='--', zorder=1)

    cat = all_causes[c]['category']
    color = CAT_COLORS[cat]

    yl = y_positions_left.get(c)
    yr = y_positions_right.get(c)

    if yl is not None:
        ax_a.scatter(x_left, yl, s=60, c=color, zorder=4, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.8)
        r90 = all_causes[c]['rank_1990']
        ax_a.text(x_left - 0.02, yl, f'{r90}. {c}', ha='right', va='center',
                  fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color='#333333', zorder=5)
    if yr is not None:
        ax_a.scatter(x_right, yr, s=60, c=color, zorder=4, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.8)
        r24 = all_causes[c]['rank_2024']
        ax_a.text(x_right + 0.02, yr, f'{r24}. {c}', ha='left', va='center',
                  fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color='#333333', zorder=5)

# Column headers
ax_a.text(x_left, 11.5, '1990', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color='#222222')
ax_a.text(x_right, 11.5, '2024', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color='#222222')
# Subheader
ax_a.text(x_left, 10.9, 'DALY Rank', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, color='#777777', style='italic')
ax_a.text(x_right, 10.9, 'DALY Rank', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, color='#777777', style='italic')

# Vertical separator
ax_a.axvline(x=0.5, color='#CCCCCC', lw=0.8, linestyle=':', alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

ax_a.set_xlim(-0.35, 1.35)
ax_a.set_ylim(0.2, 11.8)
ax_a.axis('off')

ax_a.set_title('Transition of the Global Disease Burden: Top 10 DALY Causes (1990 vs 2024)',
               fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=18, loc='center', color='#222222')

# Annotations for significant shifts

    ('Ischemic heart\ndisease', 'Rose from\n#4 → #1'),
    ('Diarrheal\ndiseases', 'Dropped out\nof top 10'),

               markersize=8, label='Communicable, maternal, neonatal, nutritional'),
